system.description:
You spin at an accelerated rate chasing down enemies and slashing into them with each pass.

As part of casting this jutsu, move up to your movement speed. You are able to pass through creatures spaces as part of this movement.

Make a melee Taijutsu attack against each creature you pass through dealing your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage] if using a weapon) +4d6 and forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, being Bruised on a failed save. A creature can only be attacked once as part of this jutsu’s casting.

Tag-Team: Your Nin-Dog follows up with a spiraling cross similar to yours. They also get to move up to their movement speed, passing through creatures spaces. They also make a melee Taijutsu attack for each creature they pass through, dealing their Bite damage + 2d6. If the Nin-Dog deals damage to a creature that failed their saving throw, that creature is also Dazed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6 for both you and your Nin-Dog.
